globalRegistration.method: joint translation scan of mean NCC between high-pass ortho texture and high-pass DEM hillshade over textured patches, parabolic sub-cell refinement
globalRegistration.interpretation: peak at the published georeference: the CTX ortho and CTX DEM mosaics are co-registered as published; single-patch scatter is texture ambiguity, averaged out by the joint vote

gate: project acceptance target: control-point error <= one planning cell (20 m)

controlPoints.name: CP1 fresh-crater neighborhood
controlPoints.method: joint vote of textured patches within the neighborhood radius; offset = shift applied to the ortho to match the DEM

summary.verdict: global registration at the published georeference (sub-cell offset); per-neighborhood offsets within one planning cell except CP2 floor-crater neighborhood, CP3 floor-crater neighborhood - those neighborhoods must be treated as carrying larger position uncertainty when sites or labels are pinned nearby

unknownPolicy: valid_mask.u8 == 0 marks unknown cells; routing must treat them as impassable and the UI must not render them as 0 m elevation
